verdict.rationale: Sketch's Symbols clearly support reusable, linked components where edits to the source propagate everywhere (sketch-docs-9, -31, -38, -53) and Nested Symbols allow structured composition (sketch-docs-24), which is corroborated by community praise for Sketch's DRY, component-based design system workflow (sketch-comm-12, sketch-comm-13). However, the evidence never explicitly describes a 'variants' feature (grouped component states like Figma's) or per-instance overrides mechanics (e.g., swapping nested symbols, text/image overrides per instance) — only general symbol reuse and library update/star mechanics (sketch-docs-10, -28, -41) are documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of variant/property groups, explicit per-instance override controls (text/image/nested-symbol swap), and independent hands-on confirmation of override behavior.
